notes: Strip b: x 2440-3760 plus ~300 px overlap (2140-4060). Streets: Baxter Avenue (L-shaped; east-west leg printed 'BAXTER ... AVE.', north-south leg printed 'BAXTER' only), Ehrman Avenue (diagonal leg printed 'EHRMAN', east-west leg east of Baxter printed only 'AVE.', assumed the same street), Haven Street, Irving Street, Purdue Street, Dick Street, Tallant Avenue, Irwin Place, West Street, Forest Avenue (diagonal 'FOREST ... AVE.' turning east at 2430,2563), Dury Avenue, Rockdale Avenue, Larona Avenue, Northern Avenue, Hearne Avenue, Albany Avenue, Louis Street, Euclid Avenue, Eden Avenue, Shields Street, Bethesda Avenue, French Street. Unnamed: curved street from Ehrman (2272,710) to Irving's north end (2350,1305), no printed name, same width and continuous lines with Irving St; and a street at the Baxter corner printed '...ICH' with the rest cut off by the plate edge. Many streets have a thin inner line drawn near the centreline; points are block-line midpoints. Not picked (outside 2140-4060): Vine Street crossings (Albany ~1995,4893; Louis, Shields, French at x~2093), Tallant/Forest (~2050,1876), Irwin Place / street at x~4135 (~4135,1638), Ehrman / same x~4135 street. 'ANDREW' and 'SYNDICATE' are subdivision names, not streets; the 25 ft way at x 3187 between Louis and Shields carries no name. Zoo interior has no streets.
